info.title: SoundSelect
info.description:
SoundSelect's back end. Every screen talks to it through these calls.

Songs come back as the **Song result** (see the `Song` schema): concert pitch and written for
the instrument, with the key's pentatonic first. Errors come as
`{"detail": {"code": ..., "message": ...}}`, with a message that can be shown as it is.

post.description:
Start making songs: pasted text, files and links, one song each. Files can be grouped
into one song or piece, and sheet music screenshots in no group make one piece. Returns at
once with a batch holding a job per song; follow it with ``GET /batches/{id}`` or the event
stream. Inputs that can't be read yet get a job that has already failed with the reason, so
every item shows up in the batch.

patch.description:
Save corrections (the key, the capo, a chord, the title) and get the song back once the
steps they touch have run again. Fields left out stay as they are; null clears one. An
empty body makes the song again with the newest version of every step.

status.title: Status

BatchInfo.title: BatchInfo
BatchInfo.description: One import: a job for each song, filled in song by song.

text.title: Text
text.description: Pasted chord sheets; each one is a song.

files.title: Files
files.description: Files: text, PDF and photos of chord sheets; screenshots and videos of sheet music; audio files. Each is read once its phase is built.

link.title: Link
link.description: Links (YouTube and others): sheet music videos or songs; see link_mode.

key.title: Key
key.description: Concert key, for a single song.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Files that make one song or piece together, as JSON: [[0, 1], [2]].

original.title: Original
original.description: The chord as it was read.

to.title: To
to.description: The right chord, as on the sheet; empty to remove it.

line.title: Line
line.description: Line number counted across the whole song.

index.title: Index
index.description: Which chord in that line, from 0.

ChordFix.title: ChordFix
ChordFix.description: Replace a chord: one occurrence (line and index) or, without them, every occurrence.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Concert-pitch symbol; lines refer to chords by it.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many times the chord appears.

scales.title: Scales
scales.description: The scale offered over this chord first, then options.

clashes.description: Notes of the key's pentatonic that rub against this chord.

chord.title: Chord
chord.description: Concert symbol (a key into Song.chords); null for 'N.C.' (no chord).

text.title: Text
text.description: The chord exactly as it appears in the source.

readable.title: Readable
readable.description: False when the text could not be read as a chord.

pos.title: Pos
pos.description: Letter position in the line, for sheets.

beat.title: Beat
beat.description: Beat from the start, for songs.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: Chord notes from the root up.

capo.title: Capo
capo.description: Capo fret (or half steps) instead of the sheet's.

page_instrument.title: Page Instrument
page_instrument.description: Sheet music: the instrument the page is written for ('alto_sax', or 'concert' for concert pitch), instead of what was read from its part name.

b_is_flat.title: B Is Flat
b_is_flat.description: What a plain B on the sheet means: true B♭ (Russian and German sheets), false B natural; null reads it from the sheet.

Corrections.title: Corrections
Corrections.description: The player's edits, kept apart from what was computed.

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: Whether jobs run in this app (or a worker of its own).

source.title: Source
source.description: What the song was read from.

source_name.title: Source Name
source_name.description: File name or link, when there is one.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the input, used to spot repeats.

instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: Instrument to write for; empty means your default.

key.title: Key
key.description: The concert key, when you know it: 'Bb', 'Gm'.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Files that together make one song, as lists of file positions (from 0); for photos of a song that runs over two pages. Read from the photo phase on.

image_mode.title: Image Mode
image_mode.description: What image files are: chord sheet photos or sheet music screenshots; auto looks for staves.

link_mode.title: Link Mode
link_mode.description: Whether a link is read for its sound (song tool) or the sheet music it shows. Read from the phases that add links.

ImportOptions.title: ImportOptions
ImportOptions.description: Options for one import. Title, artist, key and capo apply when it holds one song.

name.title: Name
name.description: File name, when the input was a file.

sha.title: Sha
sha.description: SHA-256 of the stored bytes (files, pasted text).

InputRef.title: InputRef
InputRef.description: One input of a job, as stored in the library.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: From concert to written pitch, e.g. 'M6'.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name, e.g. 'Alto sax in E♭'.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: Interval from concert to written pitch: 'M6' for alto sax, or 'd7' when the written key is respelled to avoid more than six sharps.

name.title: Name
name.description: File name, link, or the first line of pasted text.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The tool that reads it; null when none can yet.

step_label.title: Step Label
step_label.description: That step in words: 'Finding the key'.

reused.title: Reused
reused.description: The song was already in the library.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why it failed, in words for the player.

rev.title: Rev
rev.description: Goes up with every change; the event streams use it.

JobInfo.title: JobInfo
JobInfo.description: One song being made: which step it is on, and the song once it's ready.

fifths.title: Fifths
fifths.description: Key signature: sharps positive, flats negative.

concert.description: The song's key in concert pitch.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 0-1: how sure this exact key is.

signature_confidence.title: Signature Confidence
signature_confidence.description: 0-1: how sure the key signature is (this key or its relative major/minor, which share the pentatonic notes).

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Play the line this many times ('x2').

line.title: Line
line.description: Line number across the whole song, as in corrections.

box.title: Box
box.description: x0, y0, x1, y1 on the page image, in pixels.

octave_shift.title: Octave Shift
octave_shift.description: Octaves the written melody is moved to fit the comfortable range.

concert.title: Concert
concert.description: Concert pitch with octave; null for a rest.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start in beats from the beginning.

image.title: Image
image.description: Where to get the page image (PNG).

role.title: Role
role.description: 'headline' is the key's pentatonic, shown first; 'song' other whole-song scales; 'chord' the scale offered over a chord; 'alternative' another option.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: The notes with octaves as drawn on the staff, rising one octave.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Play the section this many times ('x2').

page_instrument.title: Page Instrument
page_instrument.description: The instrument the page is written for: 'concert' for concert pitch, or e.g. 'alto_sax'. A page already written for alto is not transposed twice.

part_name.title: Part Name
part_name.description: The part name as read on the page.

systems.title: Systems
systems.description: Lines of music (systems) kept after joining the views.

views.title: Views
views.description: Screenshots, or views taken from the video, that were used.

SheetMusicInfo.title: SheetMusicInfo
SheetMusicInfo.description: What a piece of sheet music was read from and how (Phase 3).

scales.title: Scales
scales.description: Whole-song scales; the first, role 'headline', is the key's pentatonic.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Version of each step that produced this result.

names.title: Names
names.description: Display names for every pitch in the song, keyed by its text without octave ('Bb' -> 'си♭'); present when names were asked for.

total.title: Total
total.description: Songs matching the search, beyond this page too.

chords.title: Chords
chords.description: The whole list of chord fixes (send the list with yours added).

page_instrument.title: Page Instrument
page_instrument.description: Sheet music: the instrument the page is written for ('alto_sax'), or 'concert' for concert pitch; null goes back to what was read from the page.

b_is_flat.title: B Is Flat
b_is_flat.description: What a plain B on the sheet means: true B♭ (Russian and German sheets), false B natural; null reads it from the sheet.

SongPatch.title: SongPatch
SongPatch.description: Corrections to save. Fields left out stay as they are; null clears one.

written_key.description: Key as written for the instrument.

pentatonic.title: Pentatonic
pentatonic.description: The key's pentatonic as written for the instrument, without octaves.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: How many notes to the player are warnings.

SongSummary.title: SongSummary
SongSummary.description: A song in the library list.

box.title: Box
box.description: x0, y0, x1, y1 on the page image, in pixels.

Spelled.title: Spelled
Spelled.description: The same pitches in concert pitch and as written for the instrument.

pdf_output.title: Pdf Output
pdf_output.description: Song pages as PDF (needs the Pango library).
